definitions.explanation: One's home or place of residence, in formal and administrative language. In everyday Japan it is met mainly in welfare terms, meaning care given at home.

examples.japanese: {居宅|きょたく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{療養|りょうよう}→療養：08207_ryouyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{居宅|きょたく}⟦{介護|かいご}→介護：04805_kaigo⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けている→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother receives home care services.

examples.japanese: ⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{居宅|きょたく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧{続|つづ}ける⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}った→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧。
examples.english: The family talked over whether she should move into a care home or keep living at home.

notes:
A formal word found in legal, welfare and real-estate documents; in conversation, ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧ or ⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧ is used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {居宅|きょたく}⟦{介護|かいご}→介護：04805_kaigo⟧: home care (for the elderly)
- {居宅|きょたく}⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧: in-home (care) services
- {居宅|きょたく}{介護支援専門員|かいごしえんせんもんいん}: care manager (the official title)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧: one's own home — the ordinary word
- ⟦{住居|じゅうきょ}→住居：11612_juukyo⟧: dwelling, residence — formal, of the building
